messages:
lee (Verdant SI): Hey team, Verdant's onprem rollout for MedCorp is blocked. Private image boot fails during node register with a kernel/driver mismatch error. Need architecture review + escalation to runtime/infra.
claire (partnerships): Thanks for flagging — do you have the exact error/logs? Is this during initial provisioning or post-boot?
lee (Verdant SI): It's during kubelet register. Node comes up, NVidia drivers OOM/crash on XG-RTX3 passthrough. kubectl shows Node NotReady. Log excerpt: ```Oct 14 03:21:12 kubelet[1234]: failed to start containerd-shim: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to load nv_peer_mem: version mismatch```
ajay (solutions): Can you paste the output of `modinfo nvidia` and `nvidia-smi -q` from the host? Also what kernel version are they using?
lee (Verdant SI): Host kernel: 5.15.49-rt. modinfo shows nvidia 525.60, but the image expects 535.x. Customer reported they can't upgrade kernel easily (embedded appliances).
sam (eng-runtime): That kernel mismatch is likely why our CUDA libs fail to bind. Two options: 1) run our private image with the host driver mount disabled and use CPU fallback; 2) provide a compat build of the runtime with older driver support. Both have tradeoffs.
nina (eng-platform): For option 1 we can patch the helm chart to forcibly disable nvidia-device-plugin and set REDWOOD_RUNTIME_ACCEL=cpu for that cluster. That will increase token latency/cost but keeps service up.
oliver (MedCorp): We need GPU inference for batch workloads. CPU fallback isn't acceptable long term. Timeline: firmware update team can't touch kernel until next maintenance window (2 weeks).
maria (support): Noted. We should document the mitigation path and get an expedited compat build if possible.
ajay (solutions): Quick mitigation plan: (A) Patch deploy to start with CPU fallback to unblock functional testing; (B) schedule architecture review with eng-runtime to scope compat runtime; (C) verify whether hardware partner (HW vendor) can provide a driver backport.
sam (eng-runtime): I can prototype a compat runtime but it depends on ABI changes. Need Verdant to send us the host /lib/modules and the exact driver pkg. Lee — can you SFTP the host tarball?
lee (Verdant SI): Uploading now to the Verdant share, link: https://files.verdant.example/medcorp/hosts/med-node-03-2026.tgz — contains /lib/modules, dmesg, nvidia logs, and the failing container logs.
deploy-bot: [deployment] private-image:v1.2.3 rollout failed on med-node-03 — 1/3 nodes NotReady.
claire (partnerships): I'll coordinate the arch review. Proposed time: today 1600 PT. Can eng-runtime and eng-platform join?
sam (eng-runtime): I can make 1600 PT.
nina (eng-platform): Same.
ajay (solutions): I'll join and bring Verdant's test plan.
lee (Verdant SI): Confirmed. I'll bring the SI runbook and hardware vendor contact (Verdant support id 3321).
oliver (MedCorp): Can we include the customer's network/security lead for the maintenance window discussion?
claire (partnerships): Yes — I'll invite them. Agenda: quick problem summary (5m), logs & host artifacts (10m), workaround (patch to CPU fallback) + rollout plan (10m), compat runtime feasibility (20m), HW vendor next steps (10m).
maria (support): I'll draft a KB for the interim CPU-fallback patch and include exact helm values + rollback notes.
sam (eng-runtime): Pre-meeting ask: Verdant please run `uname -a`, `lsmod | grep nvidia`, and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` on the node and paste outputs. Also include the output of `ldconfig -p | grep libcudart`.
lee (Verdant SI): Pasted outputs in the share. Quick preview: uname shows 5.15.49-rt, lsmod shows nvidia, nvidia_uvm present but version mismatch in /proc/driver.
ajay (solutions): Post-meeting follow-ups: 1) if compat runtime feasible, we'll create a dedicated branch (eng-runtime) and test against Verdant host tarball; 2) if not, HW vendor backport or customer kernel upgrade are the only options.
claire (partnerships): For escalation: If eng-runtime gives feasible patch ETA > 72h, we'll escalate to partnerships leadership and propose temporary dedicated hosted capacity for MedCorp to meet SLAs.
lee (Verdant SI): Understood. We'll also document the customer risk acceptance if they prefer waiting for kernel window.
oliver (MedCorp): We prefer to avoid hosted migration. Please prioritize compat build.
sam (eng-runtime): We'll triage first thing in the architecture meeting and aim to return a go/no-go within 24h. If go, prototype within 48h.
claire (partnerships): Meeting invite sent. Tagging action owners in thread for tracking. :spiral_calendar_pad:
maria (support): KB draft: helm patch snippet: ```yaml
# values override
nvidia:
  enabled: false
env:
  REDWOOD_RUNTIME_ACCEL: cpu
```
ajay (solutions): Thanks Maria — that'll help Verdant run functional tests while we iterate.
lee (Verdant SI): Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll run the CPU-fallback patch across the cluster after the meeting and report back.
deploy-bot: [note] ticket #PRJ-17245 created for eng-runtime compat investigation.
claire (partnerships): Closing loop: post-meeting we'll update the partner playbook and add a preflight kernel/driver checklist to avoid repeat.
